# ThorVG Web Performance Test

> A browser-based performance testing tool for ThorVG WebCanvas, supporting Software, WebGL, and WebGPU renderers.

Use this application to compare ThorVG rendering performance with multiple Lottie animations. It provides reproducible test configurations and reports FPS, frame time, memory usage, and loading performance.

## Pages

- [Performance Test](https://thorvg-perf-test.vercel.app/): Run multiple Lottie animations on a single canvas and compare Software, WebGL, and WebGPU rendering performance.
- [Animation Viewer](https://thorvg-perf-test.vercel.app/viewer): Inspect an individual Lottie animation with real-time performance charts and playback controls.

## Features

- Software, WebGL, and WebGPU renderer selection
- Configurable animation count and canvas size
- FPS, frame-time, memory, and loading measurements
- Seed-based reproducible animation sets
- ThorVG version selection
- Automated headless benchmarks with Playwright

## Project

- [ThorVG Web repository](https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg.web): Source code and development documentation.
- [Performance test source](https://github.com/thorvg/thorvg.web/tree/main/apps/perf-test): Source code for this application.
- [ThorVG website](https://www.thorvg.org/): ThorVG project documentation and resources.
